Release 0.34.3 extended the `GET /api/show` endpoint.

The release notes say: "`GET /api/show` now advertises each model's thinking controls and default:" [ollama/v0.34.3.md]

The example in those notes shows a `thinking` object with `values` and `default` fields. The Ollama thinking docs describe the same object, saying that "`default` is used when `think` is not set." [ollama/docs/capabilities/thinking.md]

The release notes call it a `GET` request, but their curl example sends a JSON body with `-d`, which makes curl use POST. The docs example also uses `-d`. I can't tell from this context which HTTP method the endpoint actually accepts.
